entity_raw.definition_raw:
You sense the presence of the unseen.

Prerequisite(s): Psychic Sensitivity or ability to cast psychic spells.

Benefit(s): You gain a +5 bonus on checks to notice haunts.

In addition, when you target an incorporeal creature with a corporeal spell or effect that doesn’t deal damage, you have a 75% chance of affecting the target.

Normal: Corporeal spells and effects that don’t deal damage have only a 50% chance of affecting an incorporeal creature.
